Hint do, jawab mat batao: In-effect clause: chaal ka poore board par asar dekho.

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Is key ke liye free model nahi mila. Baad mein try karo ya nayi key banao.

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Is lesson ko aur aasaan bhasha mein samjhao, ek chhote example ke saath.

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Is puzzle ka ek chhota hint do, poora jawab mat batao.

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Is setup mein galti kya hai?

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Isliye phone hall ke bahar rakho.

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Italian Game mein White ka bishop `c{n}` kis kamzor square ko target karta hai?

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Jab badle mein development, center ya attack mile

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Jab opponent koi pawn "free" chhod de, sabse pehle kya socho?

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Jaldi aayi queen ko pieces se chase kar ke development jeeta jaata hai.

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Jeet ke liye: piece activity, king attack, lagaataar pressure, opening aur middlegame ka link.

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Jeet: rook se mate diya ja sakta hai

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Jeeti hui position mein sabse badi galti?

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Jis pawn ke bagal ki files mein apna koi pawn nahi?
संकेत दें, जवाब न बताएँ: जिस प्यादे के बग़ल की फ़ाइलों में अपना कोई प्यादा नहीं?

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Jis pawn ke raste aur bagal ki files mein koi dushman pawn nahi?
संकेत दें, जवाब न बताएँ: जिस प्यादे के रास्ते और बग़ल की फ़ाइलों में कोई दुश्मन प्यादा नहीं?

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Jisme sirf dushman ka pawn hai

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Jisme tumhare apne games ke stats achhe hain aur jiske plans samajhte ho

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Jisne pehle repeat kiya woh haara

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Jo piece ring mein hai, usse chalo.
संकेत दें, जवाब न बताएँ: जो मोहरा घेरे में है, उसे चलें।

Hint do, jawab mat batao: K + do knights vs akela K?

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Kabhi piece **protected** hota hai, par uska **defender khud kamzor** hai. Pehle defender ko capture karo ya bhagao, phir piece free ho jaata hai. (Is idea ko aage tactics mein "removing the defender" kahenge.)

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Kabhi queen nahi, **knight** banana better hota hai! Sabse achhi chaal dhundo.

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Kabhi quiet (shaant) chaal forcing se behtar hoti hai: CCT jaagrukta ke liye hai, andhadhundh khelne ke liye nahi.

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Kabhi quiet chaal (bina check) mate se pehle zaroori hoti hai.

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Kam pawns se zyada pawns par attack karke unki structure todo, phir kamzor pawn ko jeeto.

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Kam theory: same setup har jawab ke against

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Kaunsa piece doosre pieces ke **upar se kood** sakta hai?

Hint do, jawab mat batao: Kaunsa piece poore game mein **ek hi colour** ke squares par rehta hai?
